research.title: Robustness of Intent Classification to Conversational Paraphrases
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to assess intent classifier sensitivity to paraphrases, separating lexical substitutions from changes in sentence structure.
Compared pretrained encoder and bag-of-words baselines under matched training conditions, inspecting prediction disagreements and documenting ambiguity in intent labels.

work.title: Inventory and Order Processing Support
bullets: Checked incoming deliveries against packing slips, recorded stock discrepancies, and routed damaged items for review according to established procedures.
Prepared order paperwork, maintained organized storage areas, and coordinated routine handoffs between receiving and dispatch staff during scheduled shifts.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Document Retrieval Methods
bullets: Implemented TF-IDF and Okapi retrieval baselines for a document collection, using shared tokenization and relevance judgments for consistent comparison.
Evaluated ranked results with precision and reciprocal rank, examining queries where term frequency normalization changed the ordering of relevant documents.

projects.title: Sequence Labeling for Named Entity Recognition
bullets: Implemented token classification using a bidirectional recurrent network and a pretrained encoder, aligning subword predictions with annotated word boundaries.
Compared entity-level precision and recall across model configurations, analyzing boundary errors and confusions between organization and location mentions.
